{{Quote|You've got a lot of guts kid. You're just lucky I was the one who saw you exit that transport.|Raan Calrissian, to the Tethan youngling|<ref name="Tethan Battle Adventure" />}}
'''Raan Calrissian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who visited [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After assisting a [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|Tethan youngling]] who had escaped from captivity, Calrissian planned to depart from Cloud City in his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Jostaar Express]]''. However, before he could leave Bespin, Cloud City fell under [[Battle of Bespin (Clone Wars)|attack]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Believing that he could not abandon the Tethan on Bespin, Calrissian went and found the [[Youngling/Legends|child]], and they departed Cloud City together in the ''Jostaar Express''.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I saw the Separatist fleet arrive and I couldn't leave you here alone. Who knows what you'd get up to?|Raan Calrissian, to the Tethan youngling|<ref name="Tethan Battle Adventure" />}}
Raan Calrissian was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Tethan Battle Adventure" />

{{RPG|''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]''}}
In circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> Calrissian was present in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], and he planned to deliver a shipment of [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] to a client on the world [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] in his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Jostaar Express]]''. However, before he could gain clearance to depart from the [[City/Legends|city]], Calrissian had to wait for his ship to be searched by a [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]].<ref name="Tethan Battle Adventure" />

As he waited, Calrissian sighted a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who were present in the city. Shortly afterward, a [[Rindoon Dart|starship]] was held up at a security checkpoint near to where Calrissian was lingering. He observed as a [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|Tethan child]], who was being held captive aboard the craft, escaped and hid behind a stack of crates. However, Calrissian noticed that the security [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that had been searching the ''Express'' was approaching, so he told the Tethan to remain hidden, to prevent the droid from seeing the [[Youngling/Legends|child]]. The droid informed Calrissian that it had finished checking the ''Express'' and that Calrissian was cleared for departure from [[Gate 134]] of Cloud City. When the droid left, Calrissian went behind the crates and removed the youngling's [[security bracelet]]s, then left to board the ''Jostaar Express''.<ref name="Tethan Battle Adventure" />

Moments later, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] initiated an [[Battle of Bespin (Clone Wars)|attack]] on Cloud City. Calrissian decided that he could not leave the youngling alone in the city, so he set out to find the Tethan. He eventually found the child, and the pair hurried through Cloud City's [[Hangar/Legends|departure bay]], hoping to get to Calrissian's starship before the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was closed by Cloud City's security force. A group of security droids allowed Calrissian and the Tethan to barge past a queue, which Calrissian claimed was something that had cost him a lot of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and the pair arrived at Gate 134. They boarded the ''Jostaar Express'', and Calrissian told the youngling to take up a position in the craft's gun [[Cannon/Legends|turret]], in case the ship came under attack. Calrissian then flew the starship out of the hostile airspace surrounding Cloud City and prepared to leave for Socorro.<ref name="Tethan Battle Adventure" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Business before pleasure, partner.|Raan Calrissian, to the Tethan youngling|<ref name="Tethan Battle Adventure" />}}
Calrissian was a skilled [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who believed in putting business before pleasure. He thought that [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|the Tethan]] was gutsy, because of the nature of the child's escape, and he also considered members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to be unscrupulous.<ref name="Tethan Battle Adventure" />

==Behind the scenes==
Raan Calrissian was created by [[Sue Behrent]] and appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]'', a book in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series. In the book, there are many different possible outcomes depending on choices made by the reader, and Calrissian features in one of the possible plot strands. After [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|the Tethan's]] initial encounter with Calrissian, the reader can choose for the youngling to try and find him again, to travel off [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] with Calrissian.<ref name="Tethan Battle Adventure" /> Raan has the same surname as the character [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], but there is currently no [[canon]]ical connection between the two.
